claim_boundary: Post-hoc restricted-rotation capacity diagnostic on existing dense Q/K/V captures. Critical masks, target bases, transform parameters, and tail coefficients may inspect held-out AV defects. No transfer, deployment, quality, or H200 latency claim is permitted.

holdouts.name: seed_holdout
holdouts.interpretation: Source basis uses seed 20260740; post-hoc target rotations are evaluated on seed 20260741.

holdouts.name: prompt_holdout
holdouts.interpretation: Source basis uses prompt 0; post-hoc target rotations are evaluated on prompt 1.

orthogonal_bcm.definition: Product of fixed-permutation-conjugated real orthogonal circulant channel blocks.

dcd.definition: Product of bounded diagonal-circulant-diagonal factors with QR stabilization.

butterfly.definition: Product of radix-2 orthogonal Givens stages; pair strides cycle after log2(channels) stages.
